checks.name: successful commit writes readable source and history
successful commit snapshots candidate instead of aliasing it
editing returned committed source does not mutate candidate or saved bytes
successful history commit copies prior events
refused workspace preserves previously saved draft and history
failed atomic source replacement preserves blocked target and cleans temporary file
missing workspace fails without creating it
regular file workspace is preserved on failed save
failed history replacement keeps committed source and cleans journal
oversized history does not roll back saved source or replace previous history
history retains the newest fifty events in order
history under storage limit is saved
missing history returns an empty array
malformed history returns an empty array without rewriting it
history beyond read bound returns an empty array
second successful save replaces complete source and appends history
missing draft reports an input failure
malformed draft fails without rewriting stored bytes
